Before you order

Ordering & delivery

4
What is the minimum order quantity, and where does Linker deliver?In the answer

There is no pallet minimum. Orders start from individual units, delivered across the EU. Equipment ships according to project schedules, with trade quotes detailing destination freight.

Can different brands be combined in one project order?In the answer

Yes. Inverters, batteries, smart meters, and accessories from different brands can be combined in one order. They ship together under a unified invoice; check each pairing against the compatibility lists on file before ordering.

Does Linker supply complete storage packages or individual components?In the answer

Both. Installers can order packaged systems with matching balance-of-system components, or source individual replacement units and accessories.

How are project quotations processed?In the answer

Quotations include confirmed B2B net pricing, a full bill of materials, and applicable freight terms for the project destination.

Accounts & pricing

2
How do trade partners access net pricing?In the answer

Wholesale net pricing is visible to verified partner accounts. Unregistered contractors can submit project parameters to receive a formal trade quotation.

Who is eligible for a Partner Account?In the answer

Professional solar installers, electrical contractors (Elektrofachbetriebe), and EPCs operating within the EU. Registrations are reviewed individually before account activation.

Shipping & logistics

3
How are lithium battery systems transported?In the answer

Batteries are classified as dangerous goods (Class 9) and transported via certified freight carriers. Systems carry UN38.3 transport certification, with compliant crating and documentation managed by Linker.

What is the procedure if transport damage occurs?In the answer

Note visible packaging or pallet damage on the freight receipt (CMR) at delivery. Linker coordinates carrier claims and replacement units to avoid project downtime.

What delivery destinations are supported?In the answer

Deliveries route directly to your company warehouse, branch location, or scheduled project sites across the European Union.

Warranty & service

3
Whose warranty applies to the supplied equipment?In the answer

Statutory B2B warranty rights apply, and product guarantees apply as issued in the documents on the product pages and in this library. Linker handles any claim for you, from your order.

How are warranty claims processed?In the answer

Open Warranty & Replacements from your order. The signed-in account confirms the order, and the form keeps the serial number, model, and fault description with that order. Linker handles the diagnostic exchange with the manufacturer's technical desk. Open Warranty & Replacements.

What technical support is included with an order?In the answer

Linker provides sizing tools and wiring references before the order, and live commissioning troubleshooting from the engineering desk in Germany.

Compliance & documentation

4
Is equipment certified for the German electrical grid?In the answer

Grid compliance is documented per model: inverters for low-voltage connection need a Unit Certificate (Einheitenzertifikat) and NA-Schutz documentation under VDE-AR-N 4105, medium-voltage systems follow VDE-AR-N 4110. Linker requests the certificates for the models in your order.

Are documentation and manuals available in German?In the answer

Datasheets and manuals are on file in English, and in German where a German edition exists. Linker's engineering desk helps with technical questions on any of them.

Are Declarations of Conformity provided with orders?In the answer

Yes, on request: Linker requests the CE Declarations of Conformity and relevant test certificates for the models in your order.

What technical documentation is available through Genie?In the answer

Genie indexes the datasheets, manuals, and compatibility matrices in this library, retrieving specific technical parameters and wiring requirements directly.

What is the maximum wire gauge accepted by the DTSU666 direct terminals?In the answer

Up to 16 mm². The current terminals of the DTSU666 accept conductors with a cross-sectional area of up to 16 mm²; the RS485 terminals take 0.25 to 1 mm².

Can one bridge join different battery models?In the answer

No. Both battery units interconnected by this bracket must be of identical model specifications. The bracket is designed for the EcoFlow PowerOcean LFP Battery (EF BD-5.1-S1), the EcoFlow OCEAN 2 LFP Battery 5kWh (EF BD-5-S2) and the EcoFlow OCEAN 2 LFP Battery 8kWh (EF BD-8-S2).

How many bridge kits should I order for two towers?In the answer

Secure both sides of each battery unit with this bracket for both towers. If each tower consists of 6 battery units, a total of 12 brackets are required.

EcoFlow Battery Stack Bridge — Battery Stack Bridge Installation Guide (EN), p. 4

How many EF BD-5-S2 modules fit one floor or wall tower?In the answer

Floor-standing: a stack of maximum 6 batteries. Wall mounting: a stack of maximum 3 batteries.

EcoFlow OCEAN 2 Battery 5.02 kWh (EF BD-5-S2) — OCEAN 2 LFP Battery 5 kWh user manual V1.0 (EN, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, SV), p. 64

Can the OCEAN 2 5 kWh and EF BD-8-S2 modules share a tower?In the answer

Yes. The 8 kWh battery is compatible with the OCEAN 2 LFP Battery 5 kWh and the PowerOcean LFP Battery. Both the OCEAN 2 Battery and the PowerOcean Battery support power expansion, capacity scaling, and mixed stacking installation.

What site clearance matters for the 8 kWh module’s cooling?In the answer

Reserve enough clearance around the equipment for installation and heat dissipation, and do not block the air exhausts during operation. Restricted airflow can cause overheating and activate power derating protection. Keep at least 300 mm between parallel battery stacks, and at least 1 m clearance from the battery system in corridors, hallways, or lobbies for safe egress.

EcoFlow OCEAN 2 Battery 8.03 kWh (EF BD-8-S2) — OCEAN 2 EF BD-8-S2 User Manual V1.1 (EN), p. 37

How many battery modules can the 10K0-S2 system take?In the answer

The 10K0-S2 supports up to 12 battery modules, with up to 6 battery modules per tower.

EcoFlow OCEAN 2 HD-P3-10K0-S2 (10 kW three-phase hybrid) — OCEAN 2 three-phase user manual V1.1 (EN, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, SV), p. 32

How do I specify a two-tower battery layout for a quote?In the answer

The technical parameters of the EF HD-P3-10K0-S2 state a battery capacity of up to 12 battery modules, with up to 6 battery modules per tower. A two-tower layout therefore carries up to 6 modules per tower.

EcoFlow OCEAN 2 HD-P3-10K0-S2 (10 kW three-phase hybrid) — EcoFlow OCEAN 2 three-phase user manual V1.1, p. 32

Which circuits does the 12K0-S2 BACKUP output actually serve?In the answer

The BACKUP output serves the backup loads connected to the AC-BACKUP terminal. The terminal provides L1 (LOAD-L1, a-phase line 1), L2 (LOAD-L2, b-phase line 2), L3 (LOAD-L3, c-phase line 3), N (LOAD-N, neutral wire) and P (LOAD-PE, ground wire). During a utility grid outage, the integrated bypass contactor opens and these backup loads are supplied by the battery and the PV modules connected directly to the inverter. Do not connect loads that require an uninterrupted energy supply, and do not connect loads whose total capacity is greater than the maximum Back-Up capacity.

EcoFlow OCEAN 2 HD-P3-12K0-S2 (12 kW three-phase hybrid) — OCEAN 2 three-phase installation guide V1.5 (EN, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, SV), p. 28

Do the AC switches shown for the 6K0-S2 arrive in the inverter box?In the answer

No. The installation guide lists the AC switch as not included. A 63 A AC circuit breaker is recommended.

EcoFlow OCEAN 2 HD-P3-6K0-S2 (6 kW three-phase hybrid) — OCEAN 2 three-phase installation guide V1.5 (EN, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, SV), p. 65

Which cables must be planned before the 8K0-S2 installation?In the answer

The installation guide lists these cables: a 16 mm² grounding cable (copper conductor), a 4-6 mm² PV input cable (black, red), a 16 mm² UL10269 power cable (black, brown, blue, grey), and a Cat 5e or higher shielded network cable as 2*0.5 mm² twist pair cable.

EcoFlow OCEAN 2 HD-P3-8K0-S2 (8 kW three-phase hybrid) — OCEAN 2 three-phase installation guide V1.5 (EN, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, SV), p. 12

How many OCEAN 2 floor bases does one battery tower use?In the answer

One battery tower uses one battery base. The installation guide lists the battery base as C1 ×1.

EcoFlow OCEAN 2 LFP Battery Base — OCEAN 2 three-phase installation guide V1.5 (EN, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, SV), p. 11

Can this floor base be used for a wall-mounted tower?In the answer

No. For wall-mounted installation, use the EcoFlow Wall-Mounted Battery Base, which is sold separately and supports stacking of up to three batteries. The floor-mounted method is separate.

EcoFlow OCEAN 2 LFP Battery Base — OCEAN 2 three-phase installation guide V1.5 (EN, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, SV), p. 17

How many PV strings can be routed to the 10K0-S2 inputs?In the answer

The inverter receives inputs from up to 3 PV strings, grouped into 3 MPPT routes. The datasheet lists 3 MPPT trackers with 1 string per MPPT for the EF HD-P1-10K0-S2.

EcoFlow OCEAN 2 Plus HD-P1-10K0-S2 (10 kW single-phase hybrid) — OCEAN 2 Plus P1-S2 User Manual V1.0 (EN), p. 8

Which cable cross-sections does the 12K0-S2 connection drawing show?In the answer

The connection drawing legend lists a 10 mm² ground cable, a shielded twisted pair cable of 2×0.5 mm², a backup load power cable of 16 mm², a battery power cable of 6–10 mm² with a rated voltage of at least 1000 V DC, and a PV input cable of 4–6 mm² with a rated voltage of at least 1000 V DC. The grid power cable is 16 mm². For the grid and backup load cables, select the conductor size based on the grid service current, local electrical code, and inverter specifications.

EcoFlow OCEAN 2 Plus HD-P1-12K0-S2 (12 kW single-phase hybrid) — OCEAN 2 Plus Single-Phase Installation Guide (EN), p. 17

Which circuits receive power through the 6K0-S2 BACKUP connection?In the answer

The loads wired to the AC-BACKUP terminal are the backup loads. While the utility grid is present, these loads are supplied to the AC-GRID terminal through an integrated bypass contactor. When a utility grid outage occurs, the contactor opens and the backup loads are switched to be supplied by the energy stored in the battery and the PV modules connected directly to the inverter. The backup function is enabled by default. Do not connect loads that require an uninterrupted energy supply, and do not connect loads whose total capacity is greater than the maximum Back-Up capacity.

EcoFlow OCEAN 2 Plus HD-P1-6K0-S2 (6 kW single-phase hybrid) — OCEAN 2 Plus P1-S2 User Manual V1.0 (EN), p. 10

Which physical parts complete the floor-standing 8K0-S2 storage layout?In the answer

The P1-S2 installation guide draws the inverter, OCEAN 2 battery module and battery base as separate component groups. The tower height sets the modules and one floor base for that tower. This page’s Linker product enquiry carries the inverter model and selected quantity; include the intended tower height there so the quote lists the remaining modules and the base for that tower.

EcoFlow OCEAN 2 Plus HD-P1-8K0-S2 (8 kW single-phase hybrid)

GoodWe

113
What backup rating does GW10K-EHA-G20 have?In the answer

For the GW10K-EHA-G20, the backup side nominal output apparent power is 10 kVA. The maximum output apparent power is 10.0 kVA (20.0 kVA for 10 s), and the maximum output apparent power in bypass is 14.5 kVA. Nominal output current is 43.5 A at 220 V, 43.5 A at 230 V and 41.7 A at 240 V; the maximum output current is listed with the same values. The maximum bypass output current is 63 A.

GoodWe ESA GW10K-EHA-G20 (10 kW single-phase power module) — GoodWe ESA Series 3–10 kW user manual (EN, V1.8), p. 281

How many MPPTs does GW10K-EHA-G20 have?In the answer

The GW10K-EHA-G20 has 4 MPPTs. Each MPPT has 1 string.

GoodWe ESA GW10K-EHA-G20 (10 kW single-phase power module) — GoodWe ESA Series 3–10 kW user manual (EN, V1.8), p. 278

Which battery modules stack with this power module?In the answer

The following battery modules stack with the GW10K-EHA-G20: GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, and GW9.0-BAT-D-G20. Battery modules of different models support mixed use.

GoodWe ESA GW10K-EHA-G20 (10 kW single-phase power module) — GoodWe ESA Series 3–10 kW user manual (EN, V1.8), p. 42

How many BAT-D modules can one GW10K-ETA-G20 column take?In the answer

A single column can stack up to 6 batteries. For single-column stacked installations, the maximum number of parallel units is 6. If there is more energy demand, or other scenarios requiring capacity expansion such as reducing the stacking height of a single column due to installation conditions, contact GoodWe or a dealer to purchase a battery expansion kit.

GoodWe ESA GW10K-ETA-G20 (10 kW three-phase power module) — GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5), p. 80

What backup load can the GW10K-ETA-G20 design support?In the answer

The BACK-UP port off-grid load capacity table in the manual lists the GW10K-ETA-G20 in the model group GW5K-ETA-G20, GW6K-ETA-G20, GW8K-ETA-G20, GW9.999K-ETA-G20, GW10K-ETA-G20, GW12K-ETA-G20, GW15K-ETA-G20, GW20K-ETA-G20 and the GW5K-BTA-G20 to GW20K-BTA-G20 models. For this group the table states: rated power of a single inductive load 1.1 kVA single-phase and 3.3 kVA three-phase; total rated power of multiple inductive loads 0.4*Pn/3 single-phase and 0.4*Pn three-phase; capacitive load 0.33*Pn/3 single-phase and 0.33*Pn three-phase; half-wave load 2 kW single-phase, with no value given for three-phase.

GoodWe ESA GW10K-ETA-G20 (10 kW three-phase power module) — GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5), p. 29

Which meter and CT arrangement must be planned for this inverter?In the answer

The inverter has a built-in meter; use the CT provided with the inverter, CT ratio 120A:40mA. If the built-in meter does not meet the usage requirements, a GMK330 or GM330 Smart Meter can be purchased from a dealer. GMK330: CT is not replaceable, CT ratio 120A:40mA. GM330: the CT can be purchased from GoodWe or separately, CT ratio requirement nA/5A, where nA is the CT primary input current with n from 200 to 5000 and 5A is the CT secondary output current. If more than 2 inverters are paralleled, or the wire diameter or measuring range of the standard CT does not meet the total current requirements of the on-site parallel system, use the GM330 Smart Meter.

GoodWe ESA GW10K-ETA-G20 (10 kW three-phase power module) — GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5), p. 35

How is the cabinet connected to the grid?In the answer

The cabinet supports TN-S, TN-C, TN-C-S, and TT grid types. It does not support direct connection to IT system grids; connection to an IT system grid can be achieved by externally equipping an isolation transformer.

GoodWe ESA GW125/261-ESA-LCN-G10 (125 kW / 261 kWh all-in-one storage cabinet) — GoodWe ESA 261 kWh user manual, V1.6 (EN), p. 14

What is needed for power limiting at the grid connection point and for several cabinets?In the answer

Current transformers (CTs) and meters must be configured at the grid connection point to enable the grid connection power limitation function. If power outage operations are permitted on-site, install a primary CT at the grid connection point and connect it to the GM330/primary meter. If power outage is not permitted on-site, install a secondary CT on the existing primary CT and connect it to the DTSD1352/secondary meter. When multiple energy storage systems are connected in parallel, insert a terminating resistor into the COM port of the last energy storage system.

GoodWe ESA GW125/261-ESA-LCN-G10 (125 kW / 261 kWh all-in-one storage cabinet) — GoodWe ESA 261 kWh user manual, V1.6 (EN), p. 46

Can the cabinet supply the site when the grid fails?In the answer

Yes. Off-grid operation is supported. When the grid fails, the PCS controls the switching cabinet to disconnect from the grid and establishes AC voltage. The system switches to off-grid operation, and PV is connected to supply power to loads; the priority for supplying power to loads is PV > Energy Storage. When the grid recovers, the PCS issues a command to close the STS On/Off-grid transfer switch, and the system returns to grid-connected operation.

GoodWe ESA GW125/261-ESA-LCN-G10 (125 kW / 261 kWh all-in-one storage cabinet) — GoodWe ESA 261 kWh microgrid user manual, V1.1 (EN), p. 26

What does the site need for delivery and installation?In the answer

The energy storage system can be transported to the installation site using hoisting or a forklift. When hoisting the equipment, use flexible lifting slings or straps, with a single strap load capacity of ≥5t. When transporting the equipment with a forklift, the forklift's load capacity must be ≥5t. The equipment must be installed on a concrete or other non-combustible surface base. Before installation, ensure the base is level, firm, flat, dry, and has sufficient load-bearing capacity. The base must have pre-embedded conduits or reserved cable outlet holes to facilitate equipment cabling.

GoodWe ESA GW125/261-ESA-LCN-G10 (125 kW / 261 kWh all-in-one storage cabinet) — GoodWe ESA 261 kWh user manual, V1.6 (EN), p. 35

Does mixing BAT-D capacities change heating or firmware requirements on this 12 kW ESA?In the answer

Mixing battery modules of different models is supported. The battery heating film is optional, and only models equipped with the heating film can enable the "Battery Heating" function. The battery heating function is unavailable when GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 and GW9.0-BAT-D-G20 are mixed. Do not use batteries without the heating film in low-temperature environments.

GoodWe ESA GW12K-ETA-G20 (12 kW three-phase power module) — GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5), p. 45

What backup load can the GW12K-ETA-G20 design support?In the answer

For the BACK-UP port, the rated power of a single inductive load is 1.1 kVA single-phase and 3.3 kVA three-phase. The total rated power of multiple inductive loads is 0.4*Pn/3 single-phase and 0.4*Pn three-phase. Capacitive load is 0.33*Pn/3 single-phase and 0.33*Pn three-phase. Half-wave load is 2 kW single-phase.

GoodWe ESA GW12K-ETA-G20 (12 kW three-phase power module) — GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5), p. 29

Are the battery base and CT in the standard inverter kit, and are battery modules separate?In the answer

Yes. The inverter deliverables include a battery base x 1 and a CT x 1. Battery modules are listed separately under the battery deliverables.

GoodWe ESA GW15K-ETA-G20 (15 kW three-phase power module) — GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5), p. 77

Which BAT-D module has the documented -20°C charging range?In the answer

The GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 and GW9.0-BAT-D-G20 have a charging temperature range of -20~55 °C.

GoodWe ESA GW15K-ETA-G20 (15 kW three-phase power module) — GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5), p. 336

What backup load can the GW15K-ETA-G20 design support?In the answer

The GW15K-ETA-G20 belongs to the first model group of the BACK-UP port off-grid load capacity table, together with the GW5K-ETA-G20, GW6K-ETA-G20, GW8K-ETA-G20, GW9.999K-ETA-G20, GW10K-ETA-G20, GW12K-ETA-G20 and GW20K-ETA-G20, and the GW5K-BTA-G20 to GW20K-BTA-G20 models. For this group the table gives: rated power of a single inductive load 1.1 kVA single-phase and 3.3 kVA three-phase; total rated power of multiple inductive loads 0.4*Pn/3 single-phase and 0.4*Pn three-phase; capacitive load 0.33*Pn/3 single-phase and 0.33*Pn three-phase; half-wave load 2 kW single-phase, with no value given for three-phase.

Can an 8 kW ESA stack be extended with a different BAT-D capacity?In the answer

Yes. The system supports battery capacity expansion, and the total battery capacity is determined by the quantity and specifications of battery modules. Configuration must strictly adhere to the restrictions specified in this section. The system supports 5-108kWh. A single column can stack up to 6 batteries. If there is more energy demand, or other scenarios requiring capacity expansion such as reducing the stacking height of a single column due to installation conditions, please contact GoodWe or a dealer to purchase a battery expansion kit.

What backup load can the GW8K-ETA-G20 design support?In the answer

The BACK-UP port off-grid load capacity table lists the GW8K-ETA-G20 in its first model group, together with the GW5K-ETA-G20, GW6K-ETA-G20, GW9.999K-ETA-G20, GW10K-ETA-G20, GW12K-ETA-G20, GW15K-ETA-G20 and GW20K-ETA-G20, and the GW5K-BTA-G20 to GW20K-BTA-G20 models. For this group the table gives: rated power of a single inductive load 1.1 kVA single-phase and 3.3 kVA three-phase; total rated power of multiple inductive loads 0.4*Pn/3 single-phase and 0.4*Pn three-phase; capacitive load 0.33*Pn/3 single-phase and 0.33*Pn three-phase; half-wave load 2 kW single-phase, with no value for three-phase.

Which meter and CT arrangement must be planned for this inverter?In the answer

Use the built-in meter with the CT provided with the inverter. CT ratio: 120A:40mA. If the built-in meter of the inverter does not meet usage requirements, contact a dealer to purchase a GMK330 or GM330 Smart Meter. GMK330: CT is not replaceable; CT ratio: 120A:40mA. GM330: the CT can be purchased from GoodWe or purchased separately; CT ratio requirement: nA/5A, where nA is the CT primary input current with n ranging from 200 to 5000, and 5A is the CT secondary output current. If more than 2 inverters are paralleled, or the wire diameter or measuring range of the standard CT does not meet the total current requirements of the on-site parallel system, use the GM330 Smart Meter. In the whole-house backup power scenario, there is no need to connect additional meters or CTs; simply set the "Meter Type" to "Built-in CT, External No Meter No CT" in the App to achieve the Power Limit function.

GoodWe ESA GW8K-ETA-G20 (8 kW three-phase power module) — GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5), p. 35

Will one EzManager3000 cover this inverter and device mix?In the answer

One EzManager3000 manages up to 4 hybrid inverters, up to 4 grid-tied inverters, up to 2 EV chargers, 1 heat pump (SG-Ready) and up to 12 Shelly devices. Compare your planned device mix against these figures.

GoodWe EzManager3000 HEMS Gateway — GoodWe EzManager3000 Datasheet (EMEA, EN), p. 1

Does the gateway work with dynamic tariffs and trading platforms?In the answer

The datasheet states auto-connect to electricity trading platforms, dynamic and negative tariff support, AI-optimized scheduling for maximum tariff savings, and AI forecasting for personalized, habit-based energy optimization. In the tariff setting you select export energy tariff or import energy tariff and set the tariff type, supporting fixed tariff, time-of-use tariff and dynamic pricing. Dynamic pricing obtains dynamic pricing from the utility company and combines it with user-set tariff surcharges to adjust the actual electricity buying and selling tariffs; it is applicable only to certain regions and certain equipment. The manual notes that only some European countries or regions support the use of electricity market tariff, and the current electricity market only supports Nord Pool.

GoodWe EzManager3000 HEMS Gateway — GoodWe EzManager3000 Datasheet (EMEA, EN), p. 1

How do the inverters, meters and heat pump connect?In the answer

Smart meters and grid-tied inverters connect via RS485. The SG Ready heat pump connects via DO, supporting a maximum of 1 heat pump. Energy storage inverters, AC charger, smart sockets and GoodHeat connect to the router via WiFi/LAN, and the gateway connects to the router via WiFi/LAN; up to 12 smart devices are supported, and LAN is recommended for communication stability. The wiring diagram shows the smart meter on RS485, the SG Ready heat pump on DO, and the grid-tied inverter on RS485. To set the heat pump working mode, select the desired working mode via the SEMS+ App after completing the wiring.

GoodWe EzManager3000 HEMS Gateway — GoodWe EzManager3000 User Manual (EN), p. 12

Are current transformers included with GM330?In the answer

No. The deliverables list states GM330: CT x 0, while GMK330 ships with CT x 3 and GMK360 with CT x 6. The GM330 scope includes the smart meter, 2PIN, 6PIN and 7PIN communication terminals, an RS485 communication terminal, a 2PIN terminal and RJ45 terminal connector, a screwdriver, 6 PIN terminals and documents.

GoodWe GM330 — GoodWe Smart Meter User Manual: GM330 / GMK330 / GMK360 (EN), p. 8

Can GM330 replace the utility meter used for billing?In the answer

No. The manual states the smart meter is intended for grid-tie point power control, its generation and consumption readings are reference only and not for billing, and the utility company's meter is the sole basis for billing.

No. The smart meter is intended for grid-tie point power control. Its generation and consumption readings are reference only and not for billing. The utility company's meter is the sole basis for billing.

No. For the GW100K-ET-G10, when the input voltage ranges from 950 V to 1000 V, the inverter enters standby mode. It returns to normal operation when the voltage returns to 950 V.

For GW80K-ETR-G10/GW99.99K-ETR-G10/GW100K-ETR-G10/GW110K-ETR-G10/GW124.99K-ETR-G10/GW125K-ETR-G10, when the input voltage ranges from 1000V to 1100V, the inverter will enter the standby mode, and the voltage returns to 1000V to enter the normal operation state.

GoodWe GW208.9-BAT-LCD-G10

When the ETR125 boost converter is paired with a battery system, the PV side voltage must be higher than 650 V; otherwise, it will trigger voltage difference current limiting.

Does GW5.1-BAT-D-G20 include heating?In the answer

Heating is optional for the GW5.1-BAT-D-G20. The datasheet lists 'Heating (Optional)' for this model. The user manual states that the battery heating film is optional and that the 'Battery Heating' function can be enabled only on models configured with the heating film. Do not use batteries without a heating film at low temperatures; otherwise, the equipment may fail to operate.

GoodWe GW5.1-BAT-D-G20 (ESA battery module, 5.12 kWh) — GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW datasheet (EN), p. 3

A single column can stack up to 6 batteries. For single-column stacked installations, the maximum number of parallel units is 6.

GoodWe GW5.1-BAT-D-G20 (ESA battery module, 5.12 kWh) — GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5), p. 80

No. The GW5.1-BAT-D-G21 has no heating. The datasheet lists only aerosol fire extinguishing (integrated) for this model, while heating is optional on the GW5.1-BAT-D-G20 and GW8.3-BAT-D-G20 and integrated on the GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 and GW9.0-BAT-D-G20. The manual confirms that the optional function configuration for the GW5.1-BAT-D-G21 is "/" (not available).

GoodWe GW5.1-BAT-D-G21 (ESA battery module, 5.12 kWh) — GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW datasheet (EN), p. 3

How many modules in one column?In the answer

The 60 kW rating, and the currents 91.0 A at 380 V, 87.0 A at 400 V, 83.4 A at 415 V and 100 A maximum, sit in the GW60K column of Grid, Back-up and Smart Port.

The GW75K-ET-G10 has a max. power of 75 kW and a max. apparent power to grid of 75 kVA. The GW80K-ET-G10 has a max. power of 80 kW and a max. apparent power to grid of 80 kVA. For Chile, the GW80K-ET-G10 max. power is 80 kW and max. apparent power to grid is 80 kVA.

The manual describes an EnWG 14a setting: "EnWG 14a: According to the German EnWG (Energy Industry Act) 14a, all SteuVEs (controllable loads) need to be subject to emergency dimming by the grid. The SEC3000C supports a maximum of 60 inverters via RS485 and 10 inverters via LAN. Check your planned inverter count against these limits.

GoodWe SEC3000C Smart Energy Controller — GoodWe SEC3000C User Manual (EN), p. 155

What sits inside the cabinet, and which CTs does the meter take?In the answer

The cabinet contains an EzLogger3000C datalogger, a 15-port switch, and a GM330 smart meter. The meter takes CTs with a ratio of nA/5A, where n is the CT primary side input current and ranges from 200 to 5000. The CT cable length should not exceed 30m.

GoodWe SEC3000C Smart Energy Controller — GoodWe SEC3000C User Manual (EN), p. 155

Where can the cabinet be installed?In the answer

The SEC3000C supports wall mounting, bracket mounting, and pole mounting. The installation location must be out of reach of children, protected from direct sunlight, rain, and snow, and away from strong magnetic fields. If there is a radio station or wireless communication equipment below 30MHz nearby, keep a distance of more than 30m. The altitude must be below 3000m.

GoodWe SEC3000C Smart Energy Controller — GoodWe SEC3000C User Manual (EN), p. 155

The ATS1-T63-A has a rated current of 50 A and a maximum current of 63 A. The maximum current of 63 A applies when the ambient temperature is between -25°C and +30°C. Between +30°C and +45°C, the maximum current decreases gradually from 63 A to 50 A.

SAJ ATS1-T63-A — SAJ ATS1-T63-A user manual, version 3.0 (English), p. 31

Which circuit breakers does the installation need?In the answer

The installation requires five circuit breakers, one for each of the following connections: Inverter Backup, Hybrid inverter Grid, On-grid inverter Grid, Smart Load, and Backup Load. Select applicable circuit breakers based on the rated current of the target connections. The circuit breakers can be installed inside the ATS Box or in the external distribution box of the users.

SAJ ATS1-T63-A — SAJ ATS1-T63-A user manual, version 3.0 (English), p. 21

Which inverter firmware does the eManager need?In the answer

A firmware update is only applicable when the inverter firmware version is not compatible with the EMS firmware version. The manual lists the minimum DSP and ARM versions per inverter model, for example H2-(3K-6K)-S2: DSP V1.030, ARM V6.040; H2-(5K-10K)-T2: DSP V4.066, ARM V1.070; HS2-(5K-10K)-T2: DSP V4.066, ARM V1.070; HS2-(3K-6K)-S2: DSP V1.030, ARM V6.040; R6-(5K-10K)-(S2, S3): DSP V1.041, ARM V1.069; R6-(5K-15K)-T2: DSP V2.318, ARM V1.069; R6-(15K-50K)-(T2, T3, T4): DSP V2.580, ARM V6.196; R5-(0.7K-3K)-S1: DSP V1.234, ARM V3.100; R5-(3K-8K)-S2: DSP V1.524, ARM V3.100; H2-(10K-30K)-(T2, T3): DSP V3.061, ARM V8.035; HS3-(3K-6K)-S2: DSP V1.135, ARM V1.040; HS3-(5K-12K)-T2: DSP V2.103, ARM V2.030. Check whether your inverter firmware version (DSP version and ARM version) is earlier than the listed ones.

SAJ eManager (energy management system module) — SAJ eManager user manual (English), p. 45

When does the eManager need external current transformers?In the answer

When the eManager works as a grid meter, either internal CT or external CT can be applied. The internal CT solution is available for current smaller than 63 A. To use external CTs, select the 50xN A/50 mA CT, wherein N is equal to or greater than 2. When the diameter of the grid AC cable is larger than 48 mm, order an additional DTSU666 (Dual RS485) grid meter from SAJ and prepare external CTs of N A/5 A, wherein the secondary current must be of 5 A.

SAJ eManager (energy management system module) — SAJ eManager user manual (English), p. 25

Which SAJ inverters take the eSolar AIO3?In the answer

The eSolar AIO3 connects to one inverter via the RS232 (USB joints) communication port. The datasheet lists the inverter communication port as RS232 (USB joints) and the number of connecting inverters as 1. The quick installation guide shows the module inserted into the inverter USB interface. The guide example shows a device type H1-3.6K-S2, but the datasheet does not list specific inverter models.

SAJ eSolar AIO3 data collector (Wi-Fi/Ethernet/Bluetooth) — SAJ eSolar AIO3 datasheet (English), p. 1

What do the LEDs on the module show?In the answer

The module has a green LED and a blue LED. Green blinking means sending data to router, green solid means the module is connected to router, green off means the module is not connected to router. Blue slow blink means Wi-Fi is working, blue fast blink means Bluetooth is connected. Slow blink is 1s on, 1s off; fast blink is 200ms on, 200ms off. The RJ45 connector has its own LED indicators: green (Ethernet) slow blink means Ethernet is working, fast blink means firmware is upgrading, solid means the module is not connected to server, off means no power supply or program fault.

SAJ eSolar AIO3 data collector (Wi-Fi/Ethernet/Bluetooth) — SAJ eSolar AIO3 quick installation guide (English), p. 1

How is the module installed and connected to the network?In the answer

Turn the module hexagon nut to a horizontal position. Insert the module into the inverter USB interface and fasten the hexagon nut in clockwise direction. Connect the RJ45 connector to the router. After installation of the module, power on the inverter. Wait for 2 minutes; if the module signal light is blinking slowly, the module is working normally. For network access, turn on mobile phone Bluetooth connection. Sign in to the eSolar O&M APP, select "My", select "Remote Configuration", select "Bluetooth", "Next", search devices and select the Bluetooth device (such as BlueLink:00012). Then choose Wi-Fi or Ethernet to access the internet. If choosing Ethernet, make sure the cable is connected to the router.

SAJ eSolar AIO3 data collector (Wi-Fi/Ethernet/Bluetooth) — SAJ eSolar AIO3 quick installation guide (English), p. 1

Contents are order-dependent; not all packages listed may be in your shipment.

SAJ HS3-5K-T2-W/G-PX — SAJ HS3 three-phase user manual, English, V4 (covers the BU3-5.0-TV2-PRO), p. 36

How many BU3 battery modules does the HS3-6K-T2-W/G-PX take, and how are they stacked?In the answer

One inverter supports up to eight batteries. For ground-mounting, a maximum of four batteries can be installed in one stack. For wall-mounting, a maximum of three batteries can be installed in one stack.

SAJ HS3-6K-T2-W/G-PX — SAJ HS3 three-phase user manual, English, V4 (covers the BU3-5.0-TV2-PRO), p. 39

What does the HS3-6K-T2-W/G-PX package contain?In the answer

The shipment contains: inverter, 24-pin communication cable connector, insulated terminals x22, PV connector x4, 1 backup load connector (blue) kit, 1 grid connector (black) kit, communication cable kit, 2 meter kit, 3 printed documents. Contents are order-dependent; not all packages listed may be in your shipment. In some configurations, the grid and backup load connector kits might be different. Meter kit A or B is included depending on shipments.

SAJ HS3-6K-T2-W/G-PX — SAJ HS3 three-phase user manual, English, V4 (covers the BU3-5.0-TV2-PRO), p. 36

How many BU3 battery modules does the HS3-8K-T2-W/G-PX take, and how are they stacked?In the answer

One inverter supports up to eight batteries. For ground-mounting, a maximum of four batteries can be installed in one stack. For wall-mounting, a maximum of three batteries can be installed in one stack.

SAJ HS3-8K-T2-W/G-PX — SAJ HS3 three-phase user manual, English, V4 (covers the BU3-5.0-TV2-PRO), p. 39

What does the HS3-8K-T2-W/G-PX package contain?In the answer

The shipment contains the inverter, a 24-pin communication cable connector, insulated terminals x22, PV connector x4, 1 backup load connector (blue) kit, 1 grid connector (black) kit, a communication cable kit, 2 meter kits and 3 printed documents. Contents are order-dependent, so not all packages listed may be in your shipment.

SAJ HS3-8K-T2-W/G-PX — SAJ HS3 three-phase user manual, English, V4 (covers the BU3-5.0-TV2-PRO), p. 36
